# CHI scope. Event 13 holds back this month: another Yuan line sent CHI an event this month (the shared global
# oe_yuan_ev_m, month index 1337.4 = 0), and the event is not yet 2 months past its window end.

    has_global_variable = oe_yuan_ev_m

}
# Any scope (interface). The crown prince Ayushiridara can be made now: never made before (global var
# oe_yv_crown_prince unset, no failed try oe_yv_cp 9), a 1337 game, on or after the birth date 1340.1.23, and the
# father Toghon Temur reigns over the Yuan.
oe_yv_cp_can_make = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yv_crown_prince }
    NOT = { global_var:oe_yv_cp ?= 9 }
    NOT = { exists = character:oe_yv_crown_prince }
    oe_start_is_1337 = yes
    current_date >= 1340.1.23
    country_exists = c:CHI
    c:CHI = { has_ruler = yes ruler ?= character:yua_togon_temur }
}
# Any scope (interface for other lines). The crown prince was made and is alive (anywhere).
oe_yv_crown_prince_alive = {
    has_global_variable = oe_yv_crown_prince
    exists = global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince
    global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince = { is_alive = yes }
}
